3. [Tech News] Building AI that can work across the enterprise
For years, enterprises have approached AI as a series of discrete experiments. Now, as AI agents begin to move into the workflows that run the business, that model is starting to look inadequate. Organizations moving from isolated pilots toward AI agents and autonomous workflows

4. [Artificial Intelligence] Your enterprise AI access can be sold for pennies – beware ‘LLM Mixers’
Underground brokers are selling access to hijacked enterprise AI accounts, with companies footing the usage bill, Google reports.

5. [Tech News] AI finds zero-day flaws for just $4 now – even mediocre hackers can cash in
Rapidly advancing AI models are making it cheaper and easier to uncover critical vulnerabilities, but it’s a double-edged sword – and a gift to hackers.
